Amul has announced a hike of Rs 2-4 per litre in milk prices, according to a statement issued by the dairy cooperative. The revised rates will come into effect from Thursday, November 12. ( Read more )

Navi Mumbai has emerged as the cleanest city in the country under the 'Swachh Sahar League' category in the annual cleanliness survey, followed by Surat and Vijayawada. The recognition comes as part of the government's annual assessment of cleanliness and sanitation across urban areas.

 11:24:18 PM IST, 11 Nov 2026 LG Sinha visits injured CRPF personnel in Srinagar
 Jammu and Kashmir LG Manoj Sinha visited Base Hospital, Srinagar, to enquire about the health of CRPF Head Constable Sonbir Singh, who sustained serious injuries in the terror attack in Kulgam and is currently undergoing treatment. 
LG Sinha tweeted, "Two other injured CRPF personnel, Constable Rakesh Das and Constable Santanu Chandra, are in stable condition and recovering at 46 Bn CRPF Unit Hospital, Kulgam..." 10:46:13 PM IST, 11 Nov 2026 Two SPOs go missing in J&K's Kishtwar, search launched
 Two Special Police Officers (SPOs) have been reported missing from the higher reaches of Jammu and Kashmir's Kishtwar district, prompting officials to launch a search operation. 10:22:18 PM IST, 11 Nov 2026 Russian Ambassador to US Alexander Darchiev dies at 66
 Russian Ambassador to the United States Alexander Darchiev died suddenly on November 11, 2026, at the age of 66, reported Reuters, citing the Russian Foreign Ministry. 10:13:32 PM IST, 11 Nov 2026 Earthquake in Shimla
 09:36:05 PM IST, 11 Nov 2026 India's net direct tax collections rise 11.76%
 India's net direct tax collections increased 11.76 per cent year-on-year to Rs 14.42 lakh crore in the current financial year till November 10, driven by strong growth in corporate tax and Securities Transaction Tax (STT) collections, according to data released by the Income Tax Department. 08:32:12 PM IST, 11 Nov 2026 Saudi coalition intercepts 3 Houthi missiles over Riyadh
 Saudi air defences intercepted Houthi missiles launched toward the Riyadh region for the second consecutive day on Wednesday, according to the Saudi-led military coalition fighting the Yemeni Iran-aligned group.
The coalition said the Houthis launched three cruise missiles that were destroyed.
The militia, which controls most of the populous parts of Yemen, has intensified attacks on the Saudi capital in recent days. A Houthi attack on Sunday damaged an Aramco administrative building in Riyadh's financial hub. 08:12:34 PM IST, 11 Nov 2026 India simplifies visa rules, cuts categories to 9
 Government of India has simplified its visa regime. Ministry of Home Affairs reduced the number of main visa categories from 13 to 9 and the number of sub-categories from 49 to 23. This follows the earlier rationalisation undertaken in October, 2025, when the main visa categories were reduced from 22 to 13 and sub-categories from 63 to 49. The step aims at making it more compact, coherent and responsive to the requirements of foreign nationals visiting India: MHA
Indian visa regime rationalization to boost foreign tourist arrivals, enhance medical value travel and foreign student arrivals. Number of fields to be filled in the application forms for all 23 visa sub-categories reduced by 65%–70%, now application process easier, faster, and more applicant-friendly: MHA 07:24:39 PM IST, 11 Nov 2026 Noel Tata retires as Chairman of Tata Investment Corp, named Chairman Emeritus
 Reuters reports 07:13:02 PM IST, 11 Nov 2026 Amul announces a Rs 2-4 per litre hike in milk prices
 Amul has announced a hike of Rs 2-4 per litre in milk prices, according to a statement issued by the dairy cooperative. The revised rates will come into effect from Thursday, November 12.

 06:45:00 PM IST, 11 Nov 2026 Indonesia's vice president has resigned
 Indonesia's vice president Gibran Rakabuming Raka has resigned, two political sources at the parliamentary upper house and Gibran's political aide Budi Arie Setiadi told Reuters. 06:26:34 PM IST, 11 Nov 2026 Eleven Pakistani police personnel feared killed in attack
 Eleven Pakistani police personnel were feared killed in an attack in the Kohat region of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province, the spokesman of a rescue group said on Wednesday. Pakistan's Interior Ministry did not immediately respond to a request for comment. 05:50:00 PM IST, 11 Nov 2026 3 Indian seafarers safe after tanker attack threat
 Union Minister of Ports, Shipping & Waterways Sarbananda Sonowal tweets, "On Nov 11, Saudi Arabia-flagged oil tanker NCC FAJR, carrying 3 Indian seafarers, was involved in a possible attack while transiting the Strait of Hormuz. All 3 Indian nationals, along with the entire crew, are safe. We are continuously monitoring the situation and remain in regular contact with the ship management company to ensure the ongoing security and well-being of our seafarers." 05:35:27 PM IST, 11 Nov 2026 Jagdeep Dhankhar collapses, admitted to AIIMS
 Former vice president Jagdeep Dhankhar was admitted to AIIMS in New Delhi on Wednesday after he fell unconscious during his morning walk. The 75-year-old former Rajya Sabha chairman has been admitted to the hospital's cardio-neuro centre and is currently under the care of the department of cardiology for medical evaluation and treatment. 06:21:25 PM IST, 11 Nov 2026 'Swachh Sahar League' in annual cleanliness survey
 Rudrapur cleanest Himalayan city, Jammu gets second position in central govt's annual cleanliness survey
 MP's Rewa secures first position among cleanest riverfront towns, followed by Bilaspur, Varanasi in second and third positions, respectively
 In 10 lakh-plus population category, Greater Visakhapatnam emerges as cleanest city, followed by Jabalpur and Lucknow
 In Swachh Coastal Town category, Puri bags first position, followed by Kerala's Alappuzha, Maharashtra's Ratnagiri 
 05:23:50 PM IST, 11 Nov 2026 Navi Mumbai bags cleanest city tag
 Navi Mumbai has emerged as the cleanest city in the country under the 'Swachh Sahar League' category in the annual cleanliness survey, followed by Surat and Vijayawada. The recognition comes as part of the government's annual assessment of cleanliness and sanitation across urban areas.
 Read more 05:21:44 PM IST, 11 Nov 2026 Officials at talks between Russia and Ukraine say the sides have agreed a large release of prisoners of war
 Reports AP 04:57:54 PM IST, 11 Nov 2026 Hijack threat to Kolkata-Mumbai Air India flight a hoax
 A hijack threat to a Mumbai-bound Air India flight before take-off on Wednesday morning that prompted security officials to park the aircraft in an isolation bay of the airport here and initiate statutory checks has turned out to be a hoax, an official said. Authorities at the Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose International Airport said flight AI 2772 will now depart around 5 pm following completion of necessary checks as per protocol.
The flight was originally scheduled to depart around 10.30 am. The note threatening that the plane would be hijacked at 11.10 am was found in the washroom just before take-off, said Vikram Singh, the director of the Kolkata Airport. 04:34:29 PM IST, 11 Nov 2026 Niraj Kumar wins bronze in men's 50m rifle 3-positions at World Championships
 India's Niraj Kumar clinched bronze in the men's 50m rifle 3-positions event at the ISSF World Championships in Doha, securing an Olympic quota place for the country at the 2028 Los Angeles Games. 04:27:59 PM IST, 11 Nov 2026 Schools evacuated across parts of Italy after email bomb alerts
 Schools in several regions of Italy were evacuated following bomb alerts received via email, police said. 04:23:56 PM IST, 11 Nov 2026 Tamil Nadu CM Vijay inaugurates Raptee.HV's flagship experience centre
 Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay inaugurated Raptee.HV's flagship Experience Centre through a video conference from the Secretariat in Chennai, marking a step in the company's expansion. 04:08:31 PM IST, 11 Nov 2026 Security heightened in Katra after firing injures 3 CRPF personnel in Kulgam
 Security has been put on high alert in Katra following a firing incident in Jammu and Kashmir's Kulgam district, where three CRPF personnel were injured after unidentified motorcycle-borne assailants opened fire at a security naka, ANI reported. 03:59:07 PM IST, 11 Nov 2026 Cabinet approves continuation of Stand-Up India financing scheme
 The Union Cabinet has approved the continuation of the Stand-Up India financing scheme, which aims to promote entrepreneurship by facilitating access to institutional credit. 03:55:46 PM IST, 11 Nov 2026 Govt to provide Rs 62,370 crore fertiliser subsidy, extend Mudra scheme by 5 years
 Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw said the government will bear Rs 62,370 crore towards subsidies on NPK and sulphur-based fertilisers, ensuring farmers continue to get DAP at Rs 1,350 per bag despite rising global prices. The government has also extended the Mudra loan scheme by another five years to support entrepreneurship. 03:19:50 PM IST, 11 Nov 2026 China auto market decline bigger than feared, Mercedes CEO says
 03:14:39 PM IST, 11 Nov 2026 Administration begins demolition of illegal multi-storey building of TMC leader Jahangir Khan in Falta, West Bengal
 Complainant, BJP Leader, Bidhan Padui, said, "Democracy has been crushed in Falta since 2018...we have been fighting against this tyranny for a long time now—not just since coming to power...we have taken the legal route against every illegal act by him. The administration has taken this step as part of the legal procedure against him. He was given a notice, but he did not pay heed. Now, the law has taken its course...I had gone to the High Court and won. This is a win for the common people of Falta." 03:10:26 PM IST, 11 Nov 2026 Cabinet approves multiple projects with a Rs 77,100 crore outlay
 Yuge Yugeen Bharat Museum (VYBM) - Rs 3,230 cr
 Noida to Greater Noida metro rail project - Rs 2,390 cr
 Fertilizer subsidy: Nutrient Based Subsidy (NBS) rates for Rabi 2026-27 - Rs 62,370 cr
 Credit Guarantee Fund for Micro Units - Rs 5,000 cr
 Credit Guarantee Fund for Stand-Up India - Rs 4,111 cr
 03:06:26 PM IST, 11 Nov 2026 Kremlin says it has no connection to US soldier arrested in UK for suspected Russian espionage.
 02:50:49 PM IST, 11 Nov 2026 Terrorists open fire at CRPF party in Kashmir, three personnel injured
 Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF) personnel were injured after unidentified motorcycle-borne assailants opened fire on security personnel deployed at a naka in Kulgam district of Jammu and Kashmir this afternoon. 
The incident took place at around 2.15 pm when the assailants fired at the CRPF personnel before fleeing the spot. The injured personnel were shifted to a hospital in Anantnag district for treatment.
(Source: agencies) 02:11:38 PM IST, 11 Nov 2026 Piyush Goyal holds talks with Canada's trade minister Maninder Sidhu
 Piyush Goyal posts, "Had a warm and engaging breakfast meeting with Maninder Sidhu, Minister of International Trade of Canada, and the accompanying Canadian delegation to discuss advancing negotiations on the India-Canada Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA) and strengthening our bilateral economic ties."
The two leaders exchanged views on the importance of a balanced and mutually beneficial agreement that delivers meaningful market access, leverages the complementarities of our economies and creates new opportunities for trade and investment.
They reaffirmed shared commitment to taking the India-Canada economic partnership to new heights, with CEPA serving as a catalyst for deeper commercial engagement and shared prosperity. 01:10:14 PM IST, 11 Nov 2026 Fire breaks out at Maharashtra Minister Ganesh Naik’s Pavanagad bungalow
 01:06:37 PM IST, 11 Nov 2026 Moody's sees Indian economy well positioned to sustain near 7% growth
 01:04:03 PM IST, 11 Nov 2026 Passenger held with over 12 kg ganja worth Rs 4.4 crore at Delhi airport
 Customs officials arrested an Indian passenger for allegedly smuggling 12.2 kg of suspected ganja, valued at approximately Rs 4.49 crore, at the Indira Gandhi International Airport here. The passenger had arrived from Bangkok via Hanoi on November 3, and was intercepted by Customs officers at Terminal 3 based on profiling. 01:02:01 PM IST, 11 Nov 2026 Bengaluru Metro Blue line train starts trial run
 Bengaluru Metro Blue line train starts trial movement, Krishna Byre Gowda, Minister for Greater Bengaluru Development & Minister for Parliamentary Affairs said. During the last one week the train moved from Bayyappanahalli Test track to KR Pura and on to Doddanekkundi station. 12:24:01 PM IST, 11 Nov 2026 Iran's army says an oil tanker is on fire in the Strait of Hormuz after hitting a naval mine
 12:22:33 PM IST, 11 Nov 2026 The ICC Board meetings will run from 11-15 November in Bali, Indonesia.
 12:21:09 PM IST, 11 Nov 2026 Tata Motors and Turno partner for customised financing schemes for electric small commercial vehicles and pickups
 Price as on 12.21.09 PM , Click on company names for their live prices.
 12:28:37 PM IST, 11 Nov 2026 Mumbai-bound Air India flight receives threat alert; aircraft moved to isolation bay
 An Air India flight scheduled to operate from Kolkata to Mumbai was moved to the isolation bay this morning following a threat alert shortly before take-off, according to ANI.
Security agencies immediately reached the spot and initiated checks as per standard operating procedures (SOP). The situation is being assessed, and further details are awaited. 10:52:55 AM IST, 11 Nov 2026 Mother Dairy hikes milk prices by Rs 2-4 per litre effective Thursday, sources told PTI.
 10:50:32 AM IST, 11 Nov 2026 Keralam govt will come out with permanent solution for power crisis issue: CM Satheesan
 10:13:49 AM IST, 11 Nov 2026 Ex-Pakistan PM Imran Khan taken to hospital for treatment, later returned to prison, sources told Reuters
 10:06:27 AM IST, 11 Nov 2026 TSMC to invest up to $1 billion in Anthropic, OpenAI
 Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) approved investments of up to USD 1 billion in Anthropic and OpenAI, as the world's largest dedicated semiconductor foundry expands its strategic presence in the technology ecosystem.
In an official statement, TSMC said its board approved an investment of up to USD 500 million in Anthropic to acquire its common shares at the company's per-share IPO price. 09:33:32 AM IST, 11 Nov 2026 Delhi HC declared Nov 16 holiday 
 The Delhi High Court has declared November 16, 2026, a holiday for the High Court and subordinate courts on account of Chhath Puja. 
November 21 will be a working day for the High Court, while December 12 will be a working day for subordinate courts in lieu of the holiday. Cases listed for November 16 will be taken up on November 17. 09:31:58 AM IST, 11 Nov 2026 IPL 2027: Hardik Pandya and Arshdeep Singh complete major trade between PBKS and MI
 IPL 2027: Mumbai Indians (MI) captain Hardik Pandya will move to Punjab Kings (PBKS), while Arshdeep Singh, India’s leading wicket-taker in T20 Internationals, will join the five-time champions.
Pandya will join PBKS at a fee of ₹18 crore, up from his existing fee of ₹16.35 crore, while Arshdeep will join MI at his existing fee of ₹18 crore. 09:26:58 AM IST, 11 Nov 2026 3 workers injured as under-construction Sachchuram Darbar gateway collapses at Rampuri Camp
 Under-construction Sachchuram Darbar gateway collapses at Rampuri Camp in Amravati, three labourers injured. Rescue work is underway. 08:40:31 AM IST, 11 Nov 2026 Pakistan vs Sri Lanka: Smog in Lahore forces relocation of 2nd Test to Rawalpindi
 The second Test match between Pakistan and Sri Lanka has been moved from Lahore to Rawalpindi, the host of the first Test, with the Pakistan Cricket Board (PCB) citing "prevailing weather conditions" as a reason, reported Cricinfo. 08:39:54 AM IST, 11 Nov 2026 Devotees gather for final Darshan as Kedarnath Dham closes for winter
 A massive gathering of devotees assembled at Kedarnath Dham to catch the final glimpse of Lord Shiva ahead of the closing of the portals of the revered Himalayan shrine for the winter season at 8:30 AM, following traditional rituals and Vedic chanting. 08:37:59 AM IST, 11 Nov 2026 6 coaches of passenger train derailed at Digaru railway station in Assam
 Six coaches of a passenger train derailed at Digaru railway station in Assam's Kamrup (Metro) district.
Kapinjal Kishore Sharma, CPRO of Northeast Frontier Railway, told ANI over the phone that there is no report of any casualties so far.
"Six coaches of the Kolkata-Sairang express have derailed at Digaru railway station at around 6:54 a.m. today. So far, no casualties have been reported. Our senior officials have rushed to the spot," Kapinjal Kishore Sharma said.
More details are awaited. 08:24:48 AM IST, 11 Nov 2026 3 dead after vehicle hits pedestrians in California, LA Fire Dept says
 07:52:47 AM IST, 11 Nov 2026 Ship carrying six Indian seafarers hit by a projectile while transiting the Persian Gulf
 Union Minister of Ports, Shipping & Waterways Sarbananda Sonowal informed that the government is closely monitoring the situation after Liberia-flagged VLCC MT FUJAIRAH ENERGY, carrying six Indian seafarers, was hit by a projectile while transiting the Persian Gulf on November 10.
Four crew members sustained injuries, including one Indian national, who suffered minor injuries and has been safely taken ashore for further medical examination.
The remaining 18 crew members, including five other Indian seafarers, are safe and accounted for. The government remains in close contact with the ship management company to ensure the safety, medical care and well-being of all seafarers.

 07:27:07 AM IST, 11 Nov 2026 AIIMS area in Delhi records 'very poor' air quality
 Air Quality Index (AQI) around AIIMS was 322, categorised as 'Very Poor', as per the CPCB (Central Pollution Control Board). 07:26:08 AM IST, 11 Nov 2026 Portals of Kedarnath Dham to close at 8:30 AM today 
 Portals of Kedarnath Dham are set to close at 8:30 AM today for the winter season with traditional rituals and Vedic chanting. 
Pilgrims from across the country and abroad are excited to catch the final glimpse of Lord Shiv. At the same time, devotees are eagerly waiting for the darshan of Lord Shiv's festival idol (Chal Vigraha Utsav Doli) and its departure for its winter seat at the Omkareshwar Temple in Ukhimath. 07:25:17 AM IST, 11 Nov 2026 Fire breaks out after a gas cylinder explodes in a hut in Mumbai's Pratiksha Nagar
 07:23:45 AM IST, 11 Nov 2026 Republicans quash effort to impeach Defense Secretary Hegseth
 Impeachment of Hegseth: The House turned aside a resolution to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, halting an effort to remove the Pentagon chief for his conduct in office and his handling of the war in Iran.
Republicans are grappling with the fallout from sweeping midterm election losses that some in the party have blamed on the war in Iran and the resulting surge in gas prices. But after US President Donald Trump signaled strong support for Hegseth, GOP lawmakers largely stood by the secretary, blocking the effort in a near party-line vote. 07:22:16 AM IST, 11 Nov 2026 US Treasury chief Bessent moved to military base after Iranian threats, NYT reports
 US Iran war lie: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent recently moved out of his home and onto a military base after Iranian threats against his life, according to the New York Times report. Iran has ramped up efforts to target US personnel, and lethal plots by Tehran against American citizens have reached "advanced stages", a senior intelligence official in the Trump administration warned in a memo seen by Reuters late last month.
